core_claim_zh: 一套置于公共地面的开放、被动、可触知语法，使行人、盲杖与轮椅使用者以及不同厂商机器人读取相同的空间状态，并要求机器遵守居民能理解的规则。
core_claim_en: An open, passive and tactile public-ground grammar lets pedestrians, blind-cane and wheelchair users, and robots from different vendors read the same spatial state, requiring machines to obey rules residents can understand.
semantic_queries: 机器与行人共同读取同一套地面符号 机器人导航 被动标记
human and robot readable physical ground markings passive navigation
vendor-neutral street grammar robot pedestrian no camera

closest_proposals.overlap: Accessibility codes, tactile and audio navigation for people.
closest_proposals.material_difference: Does not define one passive public grammar jointly read by humans and multiple robot vendors.

closest_proposals.overlap: Readable curb states and autonomous-vehicle governance.
closest_proposals.material_difference: Does not combine visual, tactile and machine translations into one open passive ground dictionary.
Does not provide an open cross-device symbol dictionary, durability protocol or public version governance.

live_repository_caveat_zh: 该审计证明在审计时点和所列检索范围内未发现同核方案，不构成数学意义或永久独占保证；发布前必须对新增 PR、Issue 和合并方案做增量复核。
live_repository_caveat_en: The audit found no same-core proposal at the stated time and within the stated searches; it is not a mathematical or permanent exclusivity guarantee. New PRs, issues and merges must be checked again immediately before publication.
